results.title: Algoritmi e democrazia, il caso Meta secondo lo studio di UniUrb
results.snippet: An Italian news article reporting on the findings of Fabio Giglietto's research at the University of Urbino. The study, which analyzed over 2.5 million Facebook posts, showed how Meta's recommendation algorithms restricted the visibility of mainstream politicians. The article highlights how these findings sparked formal inquiries within the European Parliament.

results.title: SMSociety 2026 Conference Programme
results.snippet: Fabio Giglietto was a featured panelist at the 2026 International Conference on Social Media & Society (#SMSociety) in Glasgow, UK. He spoke on the panel titled 'Meta Content Library Community Roundtable – Where to for Social Media Research?' to discuss platform transparency and future data access for academic researchers.

results.title: Research Radio on Apple Podcasts
results.snippet: Fabio Giglietto is the creator and curator of the 'Research Radio' podcast, which remained highly active in mid-to-late 2026. The show utilizes AI-generated narration to translate complex computational social science and misinformation research papers into accessible podcast episodes.
